audience: 喜欢轻柔自然治愈中文歌的音乐平台听众
style_hint: slow gentle Chinese healing pop, natural scenery, non-narrative, warm acoustic arrangement, airy vocal phrasing, clear line-by-line delivery with natural short pauses between lyric phrases; each lyric line should land as an independently singable thought, never merge several written lines into one rushed vocal run

unique_observation: 风掠过溪水时云影被轻轻推开，草叶上的雨珠在微光里闪一下
emotional_payoff: 听完感到呼吸变慢和心绪松开
